tells: 1. Front row lit by a flat, sourceless fill: the candles on every table cast no underlight on faces or hands, so the warm practicals read as decoration, not the key (club-1-wide.png, front row centre; club-2-mid.png, tables and faces)

2. The laugh barely registers over 1 s: only the white-sweater woman lifts a hand and two heads turn; the rest hold the same pose from t=12.0 to t=13.0, so it reads as idle, not a reaction to a line (club-5-strip.png, all six frames, front row)

3. Face close shows game-asset skin (waxy, no subsurface, no specular breakup) and the background blonde has a smeared low-res face and faceted polygonal shoulders (club-4-face.png, centre face and left edge)

4. The wide's front row sits in a rigid line all facing camera with hands on tables in matching poses, like a lineup rather than a club crowd; the bottom third of frame is an empty black floor (club-1-wide.png, front row and lower third)

5. Back rows are flat black cut-out silhouettes standing upright behind seated people, with tiny blue/green specks floating among them (club-2-mid.png, upper left behind the bar sign; club-1-wide.png, centre back)

3. Light is a single hard top-down pool on two rows and pitch black beyond; no stage spill gradient, no faces in the middle rows, the back is a wall of identical flat silhouettes, so there is no believable depth falloff, just on/off (theatre-1-wide.png, whole frame)
4. Face close is low-poly and plastic: the hoodie collar is faceted, the background jackets are blurry low-res textures, skin is uniformly lit with no modelling (theatre-4-face.png, whole frame)

5. Odd heads and haloes: a cap-like dark shape on the right man reads as a helmet, and a bright rim/halo outlines arms and shoulders in the mids (theatre-3-mid.png, right edge 1220,370; theatre-2-mid.png, 990,330 head)

1. Wide is flatly exposed with a muddy brown cast and no key: the downlights in the ceiling don't pool on anyone, the crowd is evenly lit like a render preview, and the floor is a black void (openmic-1-wide.png, whole frame, lower third)

2. Hair renders as stringy dithered noise at the edge of the close-up's head, and the background blonde's hand is a deformed flesh-coloured blob (openmic-4-face.png, 800-880,150-330 and 1080-1200,540-620)

4. The wide's front row is a tight, symmetrical rank all facing camera with hands on knees; the back figures at left stand stiffly (openmic-1-wide.png, front row and 290-430,280-340)
